verdict.rationale: The desktop coding agent can review pull requests through `gh`, but only as an action a user asks for during a chat session. Nothing shows it running automatically on every PR or what form its feedback takes. missing for 10: automatic triggering on every pull request (CI/webhook or recurring integration), documentation of contextual inline review comments, hands-on or independent corroboration of review quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request

citations.quote: The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
